issues.explanation: No test files are included in the diff, so none of the new Livewire actions have happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call, or tamper coverage required by tdd and the Livewire policy.
Serve mode is client-writable with no validation, so a tampered value makes CallMode::from($mode) throw ValueError (500) instead of being rejected or safely handled.
Helper callableQueues is public and therefore exposed as a Livewire endpoint when it should be protected or computed.
grantAccess and revokeAccess resolve scoped models but perform no explicit authorize call, relying entirely on SetQueueAccess to deny unauthorized callers.
Create and rename validate before trimming, so whitespace-only input passes Livewire required validation and is only rejected downstream by the domain action.
Serve permission filtering hardcodes the string call instead of using QueuePermission::Call, making the check brittle against enum or cast changes.

conventions.evidence: Domain writes go through CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket (Queues.php:121,187,220,245,253; Serve.php:386); #[Validate] used for name/renameName (Queues.php:76,87) but not for Serve mode/selectedQueueId; callableQueues is needlessly public (Serve.php:338); CHANGELOG.md:9 updated

readability.evidence: Queues.php:100-254 small focused actions with clear names matching the contract; Serve.php:334-439 ordered query and render are straightforward; Blade uses Bulma boxes/modals and {{ }} escaping with no dead code

requirements.evidence: Queues.php:94-98,136-254 scoped findOrFail plus authorize, slug re-derived via Str::slug, toggle confirmation modal without wire:confirm; Serve.php:322-332,368-401 null selection, scoped queue, Inactive/NoWaiting mapping, 10/min rate limit; routes entity.queues/entity.serve and all contract lang keys present; gap: invalid mode unhandled via CallMode::from($mode)

scope.evidence: Diff touches only Queues.php, Serve.php, Members.php activeTab, queues/serve Blade, members tabs, navbar links, routes, lang ui.php, and CHANGELOG.md:9; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: Scoped resolution entity->queues()->findOrFail/entity->memberships()->findOrFail (Queues.php:138,163,180,217,242; Serve.php:376) and authorize on mount/open/create/rename/toggle/openAccess; #[Locked] entity and lastCalledTicketId; gaps: mode unvalidated (Serve.php:315,386), grant/revoke without explicit authorize

simplicity.evidence: Reuses existing actions, policies, x-label/x-input components, and Bulma patterns; no new service layers or abstractions; direct Eloquent reads in render

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/**, no *Test.php, and no Pest coverage for queues create/rename/toggle/access, serve callNext, or members tabs including unauthorized and tamper cases

review.summary: The change implements both tenant pages, members tabs, routes, and translations with correctly scoped resolution and domain-action writes, but ships no tests and leaves Serve mode unvalidated so tampered input raises ValueError. The missing test suite plus the public helper and validation gaps require substantial rework before merge.
